title: Antevo Executive Brief
description: Market and world intelligence — the daily editorial read, risk radar and dated archive.
summary: Market and world intelligence — the daily editorial read, risk radar and dated archive.
offersHint: Market and world intelligence — the daily editorial read, risk radar and dated archive. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.antevo.ch/mcp/executive/mcp

toolsPreview.name: list_capabilities
toolsPreview.description: What the Antevo Executive connector exposes. No account required.

toolsPreview.name: get_executive_brief
toolsPreview.description: The Antevo Executive Brief — today's editorial read on markets and world events: the hero takeaway, the regime, the themes that matter, key risks and a market snapshot. Pass as_of (YYYY-MM-DD) to retrieve the brief as it was published on a past date. scope: 'retail' or 'institutional'. The full brief is large; pass `sections` (comma-separated) to fetch only what you need — e.g. 'hero,regime,what_matters' for a quick read, 'signal' for the probability layer, or 'plain_language' for the desk's own jargon-free rendering (headline, decode, signal_read, theme_reads).

toolsPreview.name: list_executive_notes
toolsPreview.description: The archive of past Executive Briefs, newest first — each with its date, title, subtitle and hero line. Use this to see what has been covered, to find the date of a story, or to follow how a theme developed over time, then call get_executive_note for the full text of a given day.

toolsPreview.name: get_executive_note
toolsPreview.description: One dated Executive Brief in full (YYYY-MM-DD) — the permanent record of what was published that day. Use after list_executive_notes to read a specific day, or to answer 'what did we say about X back then?'.

toolsPreview.name: get_executive_desk
toolsPreview.description: The longer-form desk read for today — analysis and research notes.

toolsPreview.name: get_market_snapshot
toolsPreview.description: Where markets stand right now — indices, FX, commodities, crypto.

toolsPreview.name: get_indices
toolsPreview.description: Major indices with recent history — use days_back (1..365, default 30) to see how markets have moved over a period.

toolsPreview.name: get_world_events
toolsPreview.description: Geopolitical events over a look-back window (days_back 1..90, default 7) — conflict, chokepoints, sanctions and related signals. The public cut.

toolsPreview.name: get_risk_radar
toolsPreview.description: The risk radar — what the Antevo Executive Brief judges could go wrong from here, each with its trend, impact, probability and why it matters, plus the regime it sits in and the indicators that would confirm or kill it. Pass as_of (YYYY-MM-DD) for the radar as it stood on a past date. For how risks have DEVELOPED over weeks, use track_risk_evolution.

toolsPreview.name: track_risk_evolution
toolsPreview.description: Every risk radar the brief published over recent weeks, in one call — each dated board with its regime and its risks, oldest first. Use this to see which risks are new, which have been carried for weeks, which dropped off, and how their trend, impact and probability moved. Read the boards in order and group the risks yourself: the brief rephrases the same risk every day, so match them by meaning, not wording. days_back 7..90, default 30.

toolsPreview.name: get_catalysts
toolsPreview.description: The forward calendar — dated events the Executive Brief is watching (data prints, decisions, deadlines), each with the signal to read from it and its category. Use days_ahead (1..90, default 14) to set the horizon. Answers 'what's coming up that could move things?'
